summary: Forum Markets filed an 8-K to disclose a Side Letter Amendment No. 2 to its Series B-3 Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement with Zippy, Inc. The amendment replaces a single true-up determination date for the Final Make Whole Amount with three separate measurement and payment dates (July 31, September 30, December 31, 2026). Zippy may sell up to 285,714 shares per period, with unsold shares carried forward. The company pays any make-whole amount in cash within ten business days after each date. This is a contractual adjustment to a prior financing arrangement, not a standalone special-situations event.
